newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes down amid U.S.-led jitters.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes down amid U.S.-led jitters.

text.p: IPE November gas oil futures closed $3 a tonne lower but off the session low on Wednesday after a slide in NYMEX crude and heating oil and concerns about weaker physical fundamentals in Europe led the market lower.
November closed $3 a tonne down at $227.50, having touched a low of $225.50 in late trade.
"It was a case of the jitters over what was going on in the States," said one broker.
Despite bullish API data, showing a lower than expected build in heating oil stocks, NYMEX heat failed to maintain its early gains and had lost 2.25 cents a gallon by 1655 GMT.
